summary.intent: Investigate and document two FUSE write-path bugs (data loss before remote commit on file release, and mkdir parent publish orphan) in the cipher-box project, reaching design consensus before implementation.
summary.outcome: Design discussion for Area 1 (data loss on release) was completed and locked; planning artifacts (context doc and discussion log) were committed as phase 43. Area 2 (mkdir orphan) was scouted but not yet resolved.

repo: Project uses a numbered planning phase system under .planning/phases/ with per-phase CONTEXT.md and DISCUSSION-LOG.md artifacts committed to git.
Pending bugs are tracked as dated markdown files under .planning/todos/pending/ before being promoted to a numbered phase.
FUSE write path spans crates/fuse/src/write_ops.rs and crates/sdk/src/queue.rs; read path is in crates/fuse/src/read_ops.rs.
The SDK queue crate owns publish/temp-file mechanics that FUSE write_ops delegates to.

code.finding: Contains the FUSE release handler where data loss can occur before a remote commit is confirmed; also contains the mkdir conflict region relevant to the orphan bug.
Owns queue_publish and temp-file lifecycle mechanics that the FUSE layer depends on for durability guarantees.

workflow: AskUserQuestion was used iteratively (4+ times) to drive a design discussion before writing any code, keeping ambiguity out of the implementation.
A DISCUSS-CHECKPOINT.json was written mid-session and then edited, serving as a scratchpad for evolving design decisions before being superseded by the final CONTEXT.md and DISCUSSION-LOG.md.
Planning artifacts are committed to git as a standalone step separate from code changes, providing a reviewable history of design decisions.

friction: Multiple rounds of AskUserQuestion were needed before Area 1 could be locked, indicating the data-loss scenario had non-obvious edge cases that required back-and-forth clarification.
The checkpoint JSON required an edit pass after initial write, suggesting the first draft captured an incomplete picture of the agreed design.
open_items: Area 2 (mkdir parent publish orphan, tracked in 2026-06-11-fuse-mkdir-parent-publish-orphan.md) was scouted but not locked; no context doc or implementation plan exists for it yet.
Phase 43 planning is complete for Area 1 but actual Rust implementation in write_ops.rs and queue.rs has not started.
The two original .planning/todos/pending/ files were not explicitly closed or archived after being promoted to phase 43.
